questions: How many chains did you assemble at each length, and how many showed the gap closing, the reopening and the end modes?
Why were the others set aside, for example chains that ruptured from the strain in Sec. S6?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: other chain lengths, tip setpoints, magnetic field, temperature?
What does the second-best Cr12 chain, or the same chain with a different tip, look like?
You added atoms at one end only (p. 2). Does the untouched end change as atoms are added, and do the two Cr12 end peaks sit at the same bias?

Which Rashba coupling did you use for Figs. 2 to 4 (1.8 eV Å on p. S1, 3.6 eV Å on p. S2), and how does ξM change across that range? With your inputs to Eq. (1) I get ξM near 11 Å, and 10.5 Å is about 2.2 sites of 4.75 Å.
What is your energy resolution with the 30 µV lock-in excitation at 30 mK, and how was the ±50 µeV on Δtopo obtained?
Did you measure the magnetic order of the chains (spin-polarized tip or field dependence)? The spin texture in Fig. 3 is calculated.
